authorization: User approved continuing M53 question; bounded observational diagnosis only, no training or model use
structural_pair_rule: Within one task and role only, binary Morgan radius2/2048 via pinned author featurize; 0.9 <= Tanimoto < 1.0; identical fingerprints counted and excluded; canonical/source_row order sets orientation; structure only, no label or prediction enters pairing
sensitivity: Descending similarity then endpoint row order; greedy matching before any label selection; each endpoint used at most once. Sensitivity, not unbiased sampling or proof of independent observations.
label_subset: After structure-only pairing, abs(y_i-y_j)>=1 log10 unit. Analysis subset, not full official MoleculeACE AC definition; true labels used only for evaluation.
identity: mean(e_i^2,e_j^2)=((e_i-e_j)/2)^2+((e_i+e_j)/2)^2; first is quarter squared delta prediction error, second common bias. Standard identity, not original algorithm.
metrics: contrast fraction of aggregate pair MSE
sign accuracy only in abs(true delta)>=1 subset
Descriptive Spearman of mean cached SALI / mean cached augmented risk against contrast2/common2/pair_mse; null for <3 pairs or constant, no p value
reporting: All six task/role batches x all/disjoint x all_structural/delta_at_least_1; no posthoc thresholds/cases/subgroups. Pairs share endpoints; point-MSE here is pair-weighted, not original whole-partition RMSE.
interpretation: Small delta error alone cannot certify low absolute error, learned chemistry or deployable identification. Coupling formula not reactivated. Pair labels not legal features at deployment.
stopping: Any guard/failure/budget stops; no automatic retry, threshold reduction or new group. Sparse pairs or absence of lawful identifier means evidence gap, not rescue training.
privacy: Per-pair identities/predictions/labels remain ignored; public aggregates/protocol/code/source hashes only

sources.level: Official README excerpt, .9 similarity and 10-fold potency example
Publisher-indexed primary methods excerpts: log10 difference and identical ECFP exclusion; no full-text access claimed
Correction metadata located, not used to assert identical historical data version
